title: Valkyrien Visuals
description: Early build of my modpack based on Valkyrien skies and Visuals mods
body:
In this modpack, I have combined maximum performance and beauty using a beautiful sky and other interesting projects.

In my build, I have the following mechanics
- Realistic clouds
- Large draw distance
- Advanced cooking
- Physical capabilities
- Magic
- New generation
- And a large set of add-ons for Create

****For optimization
This modpack is designed for more powerful computers.
You can disable Distant Horizon for performance gains****
